name: add_tasktracker_dockerfile
description: Repo-scale devops: containerize the tasktracker app - production-shaped Dockerfile (slim base, no-cache pip, non-root user, uvicorn CMD) + .dockerignore
prompts: Containerize this fastapi-tasktracker repo for production. Write a Dockerfile at the repo root: base it on a python:3.x-slim image, install dependencies from the repo's requirements.txt with pip --no-cache-dir, copy in the application code, and start it with uvicorn serving app.main:app on host 0.0.0.0 port 8000 (EXPOSE 8000; no dev-server flags like --reload). The container must NOT run as root: create a dedicated user and switch to it with USER after the dependency install. Also add a .dockerignore at the repo root that keeps at least __pycache__, .git, the tests/ directory, and *.db files out of the build context.

test_setup_files.check_dockerfile.py:
import re
from pathlib import Path

df_path = Path("Dockerfile")
assert df_path.is_file(), "Dockerfile missing at repo root"
raw = df_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

# join backslash line-continuations, drop comments and blanks
joined = re.sub(r"\\\s*\n", " ", raw)
lines = [l.strip() for l in joined.splitlines() if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]


def instr(name):
    return [(i, l) for i, l in enumerate(lines) if l.upper().startswith(name + " ")]


froms = instr("FROM")
assert froms, "no FROM instruction"
final_from = froms[-1][1]
assert re.search(r"python:3\.\d+-slim", final_from), (
    f"final stage must use a python:3.x-slim base image, got: {final_from}")

pip_lines = [(i, l) for i, l in instr("RUN") if "pip" in l and "install" in l]
assert pip_lines, "no RUN pip install instruction"
pip_all = " ".join(l for _i, l in pip_lines)
assert "--no-cache-dir" in pip_all, "pip install must use --no-cache-dir"
assert "requirements.txt" in pip_all, "dependencies must be installed from requirements.txt"

users = instr("USER")
assert users, "container must not run as root: add a USER instruction"
last_user_idx, last_user_line = users[-1]
user_name = last_user_line.split()[1]
assert user_name not in ("root", "0"), f"USER must be non-root, got {user_name!r}"
assert last_user_idx > pip_lines[-1][0], (
    "the non-root USER must take effect AFTER dependency installation "
    "(pip needs root in a slim image; the runtime process must not have it)")

cmds = instr("CMD") + instr("ENTRYPOINT")
assert cmds, "no CMD or ENTRYPOINT"
cmd_all = " ".join(l for _i, l in cmds)
for needle in ("uvicorn", "app.main:app", "0.0.0.0"):
    assert needle in cmd_all, (
        f"start command must run uvicorn app.main:app bound to 0.0.0.0 (missing {needle!r})")
assert "--reload" not in raw, "--reload is a dev-server flag and has no place in the image"

expose_all = " ".join(l for _i, l in instr("EXPOSE"))
assert "8000" in expose_all, "EXPOSE 8000 missing"

copy_lines = [l for _i, l in instr("COPY") + instr("ADD")]
assert any(re.search(r"^(COPY|ADD)\s+(--\S+\s+)*(\.|\./|app)", l, re.IGNORECASE) for l in copy_lines), (
    "application code is never copied into the image (expected COPY of app/ or the build context)")

di = Path(".dockerignore")
assert di.is_file(), ".dockerignore missing"
entries = [l.strip() for l in di.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
           if l.strip() and not l.strip().startswith("#")]
for req in ("__pycache__", ".git", "tests", "*.db"):
    assert any(req in e for e in entries), f".dockerignore must exclude {req}"

print("PASS structural Dockerfile checks")

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM python:3.12-slim

WORKDIR /srv/tasktracker

COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY app ./app
COPY alembic ./alembic
COPY alembic.ini ./

RUN useradd --create-home tasktracker
USER tasktracker

EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8000"]
